Chinese Military Mouthpiece Hails Removal of Two Generals

China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) mouthpiece has praised the recent expulsion of two top generals from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and the PLA. The mouthpiece stated that their removal would enhance the "purity and honour" of the military, enabling it to better accomplish its missions. The downfall of these chiefs was described as eliminating a "political danger."
